statistics.legend.sequential: Light → dark: low → high values. Compare using this indicator's value ranges

statistics.details.countsAtlas: Observed true 0: {zero}; not applicable: {notApplicable}; no data: {missing}; removed by the source: {suppressed}. The last three are not 0 and are hatched.
statistics.details.countsLandslide: Observed true 0: {zero}; not listed: {missing}. Unlisted areas are hatched and are not 0.
statistics.details.countsDemographics: Observed true 0: {zero}; missing: {missing}. Missing values are hatched and not filled with 0.
statistics.details.countsLabor: Observed true 0: {zero}; not covered by the source (source_not_covered): {notCovered}; source join / time mismatch (source_join_or_time_mismatch): {mismatch}. The three are not interchangeable.
